g.text: Attention study: head counts, dropout and their interaction
Top: marginal validation changes, with other attention settings averaged within split. M1 uses the three complete grids (splits 0, 1, 4); M2/M3 use all five.
Six M1 screens failed with CUDA OOM in the other two splits. Bottom: M3 averages mean/CLS, then compares with T=4, G=4, dropout=0 within each split.
Width 96 for M1/M3; all GAT layers use the chosen head count. Seed-0, 12-epoch screening results only; no held-out inference from individual cells.
